description: Fictional circular addressed to asset management companies; Acme is a stock broker.

extraction.summary: Asset management companies must publish scheme total expense ratios daily and notify unit holders three working days before any change to the base TER.

obligations.requirement: Disclose each scheme's total expense ratio daily on the AMC and AMFI websites.

evidence.text: Asset management companies shall disclose the total expense ratio of each scheme on a daily basis on their websites and on the website of the Association of Mutual Funds in India

obligations.requirement: Notify unit holders at least three working days before changing the base total expense ratio.

evidence.text: Any change in the base total expense ratio shall be communicated to unit holders at least three working days in advance by email or SMS.

impact.reason: The circular addresses mutual funds and asset management companies. Acme is a SEBI-registered stock broker with no mutual fund or AMC registration and does not manage schemes.

regulatory_evidence.text: This circular applies to all mutual funds and asset management companies
